g.text: lazyplan — plan journal for you and your agent
j/k, up/down, click move cursor / select
left/right, click arrow fold / unfold row
space mark the selected row for bulk actions
z fold or unfold the selected row
Z fold or unfold every row
n new plan / milestone / task by context
a add a criterion to the selection
s advance status: todo → doing → done
x tick the next open criterion
d delete the selection after a confirm
